# n8n-selfhost.dev Knowledge Base

## What is n8n-selfhost.dev?

Open-source template for automated n8n deployment.
Code-first development, zero-touch production.

## Core Value

"Code-First n8n Development: Build locally, deploy anywhere, zero-touch production"

## Target Audience

- Automation developers building n8n-based products
- Agencies deploying n8n for clients
- DevOps engineers wanting Infrastructure as Code for n8n
- AI/ML engineers building AI agent workflows

## Problems We Solve

1. Manual owner account creation → Auto-bootstrap via API
2. Manual credential import via CLI → JSON files, auto-import, secure delete
3. No programmatic workflow deployment → Git-based workflows, auto-import on start
4. No local development environment → Full local dev with hot-reload and tests
5. Sub-workflow IDs break on migration → Automatic dependency resolution
6. Enterprise-only CI/CD features → Free for Community Edition

## Key Features

### 1. Zero-Touch Production Deploy
- Deploy fully configured n8n without opening UI
- Owner account, credentials, workflows — all automated
- One command: docker compose up → working instance

### 2. Code-First Workflow Development
- AI agents write workflows as JSON files
- No clicking in editor — pure code
- Version control with Git
- Test locally before deploy

### 3. Local-First Development Flow
AI writes workflows (JSON) → Tests run locally → Git commit → Deploy to prod → Ready

### 4. AI-Agent Ready
- Credentials for AI services out of the box
- OpenRouter, OpenAI, Anthropic integrations
- MCP server support

### 5. Reproducible Instances
- Same result on any server
- Copy to new projects with minimal changes
- Infrastructure as Code approach

## Limitations

- No incremental updates of existing workflows on production
- No migration/sync between environments
- No hot-reload on production

Current scope: Production deployment FROM SCRATCH only.

## Quick Start

1. git clone https://github.com/narasim-dev/n8n-boilerplate
2. cd n8n-boilerplate
3. cp .env.example .env
4. Edit .env with your encryption key
5. docker compose up --build

## Architecture

docker/n8n/n8n/
├── Dockerfile
├── entrypoint.sh
├── scripts/
│   ├── bootstrap.sh (Auto-setup)
│   └── workflow-sync.sh (Import/export)
├── workflows/ (JSON workflow files)
├── credentials/ (Credential JSON files)
└── databases/knowledge/ (MindLogs SQLite)
